India's EAM Jaishankar discusses trade, multilateralism with UAE and Canada

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar has called for "urgent" reform of multilateralism, highlighting the partnership between India and the UAE. He also met with his Canadian counterpart to discuss trade, energy, and defense, with both nations pushing for a trade pact by year-end. Progress on this pact was reviewed in New Delhi.
